messages:
morgan: Quick follow-up from the DR postmortem — consolidating owners and deadlines so we can close loop on recurring failover gaps. Please reply with confirmations or updates.

liam: I can take the routing checklist updates. Will add a section on conditional fallback rules for EU->US routing and TTL guidance. Target EOD Thu. :checkered_flag:

sara: taking backups/restore runbook updates. Need to add validation steps after snapshot restore (checksum + smoke tests). Will PR to runbooks by Mon.

anika: I’ll coordinate game-day scheduling and run a dry-run with infra next Wed. Can we lock a 2hr window 9-11am PT? ops-bot please add provisional event.

ops-bot: Calendar event created: DR dry-run (provisional) 2026-04-01 09:00-11:00 PT. Reminder 3 days before.

liam: quick note on routing pattern we saw — BGP flaps on peering caused traffic steering to fall back to the warm standby in us-west-2. Suggest adding health-check gating to the routing policy. Will add pseudo-config example.

liam: ```yaml
route53:
  failover-policy: weighted-then-fallback
  primary-region: eu-central-1
  fallback-region: us-west-2
  health-checks:
    - path: /_live
      threshold: 2
      interval: 10
```

sara: For backups: lab snapshot + offsite replication. Current gap = replication lag during heavy ingest windows. Action: enable incremental snapshot throttling + daily integrity report. Owner: sara. Due: 2026-03-30.

morgan: owners + quick statuses so exec can track:
- Routing checklist & health gating: liam — EOD Thu (in progress)
- Restore runbook + smoke tests: sara — Mon (in progress)
- Game-day dry-run orchestration and invite: anika — Wed (blocked: need infra confirmation)
- S3 cross-region replication audit: derek — assign?

derek: I can take the S3 CRR audit. Will produce audit table of buckets, replication status, mm/dd of last successful replication and any missing KMS grants. Target Fri COB.

elaine: From storage team: we also saw a recurring pattern where incremental snapshot consolidation failed when disk pressure > 85% — adding an early-warning alert to avoid partial consolidations. Owner: elaine. Due: next Tue.

morgan: great. Can we add a brief RACI doc inline here so follow-ups are clear? R = owner, A = morgan, C = infra/eng, I = stakeholders.

morgan: RACI quick table:
- Routing gating: R=liam, A=morgan, C=infra, I=platform + SRE
- Restores + smoke tests: R=sara, A=morgan, C=storage, I=eng-oncall
- Game-day orchestration: R=anika, A=morgan, C=infra/events, I=all DR owners
- S3 replication audit: R=derek, A=morgan, C=security, I=eng-storage
- Snapshot alerting: R=elaine, A=morgan, C=metrics, I=storage/ops

liam: tagging a PR link for the routing doc as soon as ready. Also putting a TODO to evaluate cross-region CDNs for quicker failover for static assets.

sara: question: for smoke tests do we want a minimal traffic replay or synthetic probes? leaning synthetic for speed. Thoughts?

anika: synthetic probes + small replay for critical flows (auth, payments). keep replay capped to avoid billing surprises.

morgan: agree. synthetic for quick validation, replay for end-to-end once smoke passes. Add a canary user traffic script to the runbook.

derek: FYI I found 3 buckets with replication disabled in eu region. Will include commands to re-enable and a suggested patch script. Example: `aws s3api put-bucket-replication --bucket X --replication-configuration file://rep.json`

elaine: adding alert: `snapshot.consolidation.disk_pressure > 80% -> preemptive-throttle` and playbook note to revert if false-positive.

morgan: can everyone drop a one-line status update here by EOD so I can publish the consolidated tracker to execs?

liam: Done — routing doc drafted, need review from infra.

sara: Done — runbook PR open (link: https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/restore-pr-123).

anika: Done — tentative dry-run scheduled, infra to confirm.

derek: Done — audit CSV in my drive, will attach to tracker.

morgan: thanks. Closing notes: recurring incident pattern summary for the deck —
1) routing fallbacks during peering flap -> mitigations: health-check gating + TTL tuning + canary failover
2) snapshot consolidation failing under high disk pressure -> mitigations: early alert + throttle
3) replication gaps during heavy ingest -> mitigations: incremental snapshot throttling + audit + KMS grant reconciliation

morgan: Will publish tracker w/ owners and dates by tomorrow morning and ping this thread. If any deadlines slip, update here so the tracker stays accurate. :eyes: :spiral_calendar:
